verdict.rationale: Workable is a recruiting/HR SaaS platform, not an AI agent or orchestration tool; the evidence only shows Workable exposing its own MCP server for others to consume (workable-docs-4, workable-docs-19, workable-probe-4), not any capability for Workable itself to plug in and consume external MCP servers' tools. This axis (acting as an MCP client/host) is a category mismatch for this kind of product.
